name: GSM-Symbolic
description: A framework from Apple ML Research that creates symbolic templates from GSM8K problems to generate diverse question variants by changing names, numbers, and contextual details while preserving logical structure. Demonstrates that LLMs replicate reasoning patterns from training data rather than performing genuine logical reasoning — performance drops significantly on symbolic variants that are logically identical to familiar problems.
typical_sota_score: Performance drops of 1–15% on symbolic variants vs. originals; adding irrelevant clauses further drops performance significantly
reputation: ICLR 2025 Spotlight; from Apple ML Research; widely discussed as evidence that LLM math reasoning is fragile and contamination-dependent; significant methodological contribution to contamination detection
notes: ICLR 2025 Spotlight. From Apple ML Research. Key finding: models show significant performance variance on logically equivalent symbolic variants, suggesting pattern matching rather than reasoning. Performance drops when irrelevant but mathematically plausible clauses are added (suggesting models are distracted by irrelevant information). Companion paper 'GSM-NoOp' shows further evidence: models include irrelevant numbers in calculations. Prompted fundamental reconsideration of what math benchmark scores mean.
